area: Nord Avenue & Hageman Road, northwest Bakersfield
summary: Reports of flames at Nord Avenue and Hageman Road drew Engine 67, Engine 65, Truck 65 and Battalion 6. Crews found about a half-acre of brush and grass burning in a field — a spot the reporting party said is known for bonfires — and called for one additional engine. No structures involved; an Edwards Air Force Base water tender was offered as backup.

area: Morning Drive, between College and Highland
summary: A vehicle on the roadway near Morning Drive fled into a dirt field between College and Highland, with Air 1 called up and multiple off-road vehicles reported in the area. Broadcast citywide as an attempt-to-locate; no arrest announced on the air.
Caller reported 150 to 250 vehicles gathering in a furniture store parking lot, prompting multiple units and an Air 1 request. No further update was heard before the feed moved on.
A 415 involving five to six subjects, with a female in a yellow shirt and shorts reported displaying a taser. Units were responding as the feed moved on.
A caller in a white van west of the AM/PM on Highway 119 reported subjects attempting to attack him. Deputies were checking the area; possible 9-18 broadcast.
415 and a reported theft at the Dollar General on Niles Street, with transient subjects described. Units responded.
Open 911 line with a verbal disturbance in the background at a Goodman Street location; callers back on the line requesting law enforcement. No further update heard.
Multiple subjects arguing on Rosedale Highway, with one intoxicated subject wanting to ride a bike home. Units responded.
Smoke from an air conditioner at an East 19th Street address drew a heavy response — Engine 2, Engine 41, Truck 41, Battalion 1 and Rescue 2.
Vandalism in progress at a residence — a neighbor and the homeowner both called in a female on the back porch damaging items. Units responded.
Gray Jeep Wrangler reported driving recklessly through 23rd and Chester Avenue, last seen eastbound.
Yellow sedan at Bernard Street and Jefferson Park with windows open and fumes reported coming from it; caller concerned. Units checked the vehicle.
Male in a baseball cap, white sweatshirt and black shorts reported set up on a building in the 1200 block of 19th Street. Units responded.
Outside fire in a rural area of the county drew Engine 46. Street names garbled on the air; no further update heard.
Welfare check at the downtown bus terminal for a female in her 50s dressed in all black with belongings in a shopping cart. Units responded.
